svg.title: Potential, kinetic and total energy in undamped simple harmonic motion

cc:Work.dc:title: Potential, kinetic and total energy in undamped simple harmonic motion
cc:Work.dc:description: Potential and kinetic energy are complementary parabolas against displacement, and cosine-squared and sine-squared curves against time. Each energy repeats twice during one displacement period; total energy is constant.
